name: Vodafone Idea Ltd.
business_summary: India's third-largest mobile operator (193.1m subscribers at Jun-2026; ARPU Rs195 in Q1 FY27, 4G/5G-led recovery after years of subscriber losses). Revenue Rs45.5k cr TTM, EBITDA margin ~43%, but interest (~Rs20.7k cr TTM) exceeds EBITDA; the Mar-2026 quarter profit of Rs51,970 cr was a one-off gain tied to the AGR relief, not operations. The government owns ~49% after converting dues to equity; Aditya Birla/Vodafone promoters hold ~25.6%. Survival and equity value hinge on (a) tariff hikes, (b) AGR/spectrum dues relief and deferral, (c) Rs35,000 cr bank funding for a Rs45,000 cr 3-year capex plan, (d) stabilising subscriber share against Jio and Airtel.

revenue_mix.segment: mobile services (prepaid ~ 90% of subs, postpaid remainder)
revenue_mix.geography: India 100% (Mumbai, Delhi, Gujarat, UP, Kerala, etc. 17 priority circles for 5G/4G)

cost_structure.input: network opex incl. tower rentals & energy (largely Indus Towers, Airtel-owned and others)
licence fees/spectrum usage charges (~8% of AGR) and regulatory levies

exposures.mechanism: +10% ARPU on a Rs45.5k cr revenue base (TTM) = ~+Rs4.1k cr, almost all dropping to EBITDA because network opex is largely fixed: TTM EBITDA Rs19.4k cr so EBITDA +21%. Net debt incl. AGR/spectrum dues is ~Rs2 lakh cr-scale (model knowledge, unverified) vs mcap Rs1.39 lakh cr so EV/MCap ~2.3; persistence 0.5 (competition/churn erodes part of a hike within 1-2 yrs) => +21*2.3*0.5 = ~+24, trimmed to +22 for churn risk. Highest-leverage channel: Vi ARPU Rs195 vs Airtel Rs264 leaves headroom, and Airtel's Oct-2026 postpaid +Rs50 hike plus complimentary roaming shows hikes are resuming. Empirical pack sensitivities show no significant tariff proxy (factor not in the 30-series), so no data conflict.

exposures.mechanism: Govt has frozen AGR dues at ~Rs87,695 cr (reported, subject to reassessment) with capped annual payments (Rs124 cr/yr x6, Rs100 cr/yr x4 then balance later, reported) and holds ~49% via dues-to-equity. One further SSU = additional relief/reassessment/deferral worth ~Rs20k cr NPV; against mcap Rs1.39 lakh cr that is ~+14% of equity if fully equity-accruing; persistence 1.0 (structural) but haircut for the share already priced after the Dec-2025/2026 relief and dilution risk => +12. Spectrum dues of Rs7k/15k/28k cr in FY27/28/29 make deferral or restructuring the single biggest swing factor (HSBC bearish on this overhang, 2026-09-08).
